source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Corvette Body, p.1B-7

procedures.title: Cowl ventilator assembly: adjust
steps: Turn the plastic adjustment link midway along the control cable under the dash to set the adjustment.
Set it so the ventilator valve is fully shut with the knob pushed forward.
notes: Applies to left or right side; see figure 20 in the manual.

procedures.title: Cowl ventilator assembly: remove and install
steps: Take off the cowl kick panel.
Free the control cable from its bracket by removing the screw.
Lift out the console trim plate and remove the nut holding the guide.
Remove the screw securing the cable at the inside front of the console.
Disconnect the cable at the adjusting link and pull it through to remove.
Install in reverse order, then check operation and adjust.

procedures.title: Door lock striker: adjust
steps: For up/down or in/out: loosen the striker bolt, move it as needed and retighten.
To check fore/aft: first confirm the door is aligned correctly.
Put modeling clay or body caulking compound in the lock bolt opening (see figure 21 in the manual).
Close the door just far enough for the striker to leave an impression.
Measure the striker impression as described next.
notes: The striker is one bolt-and-washer threaded into a floating tapped cage plate in the lock pillar; the lock fork-bolt snaps over it to hold the door shut.
Caution: do not shut the door fully on the clay; that makes the clay very hard to remove.
